integrity: Reproducibility tests are corroboration, not proof of all parameter values; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete split graphs only: a clique joined to an independent set; unit graph distance.
No claim to a formula for all split graphs, arbitrary graph metrics or nonisometric embeddings.
Older two-distance embedding literature may contain an equivalent specialization; this has not been ruled out exhaustively.
title: Seven-vertex obstruction and sharp negative-type gap of complete split graph metrics
